name: @clawdhq/circle
description: Portable (non-Next.js) home for every Circle developer-platform integration this app uses: Circle Wallets (owner-facing embedded wallets), CCTP/Bridge Kit (cross-chain USDC into Arc), and Gateway (unified USDC balance / instant settlement — the primitive Circle now markets as Nanopayments). Consumed by apps/web (owner-triggered routes) and, for the Gateway settlement path, the same custody-core execution engine the x402 facilitator already uses.
